why: This is a named benchmark dataset built from a single occupational-therapy licensing examination, not a general instructional element.
name: 60th Japanese National Examination for Occupational Therapists (2025) multimodal benchmark dataset
product_description: A dataset of 199 official Japanese occupational-therapy licensing-exam questions, including text-only, visually based, and case-based items, released and used by Saita Kazuya et al. to benchmark multimodal LLMs.
